caveats: Notes and their timing are recovered from the register log.
Velocity is estimated from carrier Total Level at key-on.
The tempo grid is inferred; `grid_fit` is the confidence.
Vibrato is recovered, with its measured depth and speed. Portamento and volume ramps are not.
Which drum a DAC hit was is not recovered; all read as `kick`.
Two DAC hits closer together than the first sample's length leave no gap in the byte stream and read as one hit.
`tuning_cents` is the track's own pitch reference against A440; several of these games are not tuned to it.
